TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
1616 West 17th Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 1616 West 17th Street from an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a RM-6 Residential Multi-Unit Districts to bring
the existing density and bulk characteristics into compliance with the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance. The subject property is improved with a three-story multifamily residential
building with 10 dwelling units and two parking spaces. The existing building’s footprint
and use will remain unchanged. No commercial space will be provided. The building’s
height of 47.06 feet will remain unchanged.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks the following variations: (1) to
reduce the front setback to zero, and (2) to reduce the west and combined side setbacks
to 0 feet pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B. The Applicant will also seek an administrative
adjustment to (1) reduce the required parking to 2 spaces pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-
EE, and (2) reduce the required on-site open space to 303.11 square feet pursuant to
Section 17-13-1003-W.
